reason: I'm actively building out the no-alcohol list and guests want drinks that aren't just sugar, so a fermented local base is exactly what I'm hunting for. I'd ask for the free sample first, and if it holds up in a mocktail I'd order one litre to test on the menu, not more.
objection: A small producer might run out of stock in high season, and I can't put a signature drink on the menu that disappears in December. Also 23 euros a litre is two to three times what I pay my main distributor for syrups.
